content.introduction: GeekWire reports on several significant tech developments, including a solo founder using AI to build a music licensing platform for small businesses, the acquisition of Truelist by Mainstay for $18M, and the merger of Seattle startups DexCare and Mila Health to expand AI patient scheduling. Other highlights include Microsoft AI executive joining Niantic Spatial, Hubble Network raising $200M to reach $1.6B valuation, and Amazon opening its seller tools to outside AI agents starting with Anthropic’s Claude. Additionally, GeekWire covers layoffs at Expedia Group and the acquisition of Seattle startup Row Zero by Databricks. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on some of these developments.

# About GeekWire

GeekWire is a fast-growing, national technology news site with strong roots in the Seattle region and a large audience of loyal, tech-savvy readers around the globe. Founded in 2011, GeekWire is uniquely positioned to cover some of the most widely followed and innovative tech companies in the world, and one of the most vibrant startup markets in the country.
